abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is dependent on autophagy for growth. Chloroquine/Hydroxychloroquine (CQ/HCQ), the sole FDA-approved autophagy inhibitors, have shown limited clinical efficacy in cancer. To identify approaches to enhance CQ-mediated growth suppression, we performed a CQ-anchored, CRISPR-Cas9 mediated loss-of-function screen. We identified that the loss of genes encoding proteins upstream in the autophagy pathway enhanced CQ-induced growth inhibition. This indicated that simultaneous targeting of two distinct nodes of the same pathway, vertical inhibition, may be a more effective strategy than single node inhibition. We demonstrated that genetic loss or pharmacological inhibition of VPS34, a protein necessary for autophagosome nucleation, sensitized PDAC cells to inhibitors of the terminal stage of the autophagy pathway, including CQ and an inhibitor of PIKfyve. We extended this concept to the initiation complex and demonstrated that ULK1/2 inhibition synergized with CQ and PIKfyve inhibition to impair PDAC cell growth and increase apoptosis. Anticipating mechanisms of resistance to vertical autophagy inhibition, we performed reverse-phase protein array profiling and identified that vertical inhibition of the autophagy pathway resulted in enhanced activation of the PI3K-AKT-mTORC1 signaling pathway. Increased mTORC1 signaling resulted in heightened sensitivity to bi-steric mTORC1 inhibition in both cell line and organoid models of PDAC. In conclusion, vertical inhibition of the autophagy pathway enhances growth suppression in PDAC. Implications: Compensatory upregulation of upstream nodes of the autophagy pathway limits the efficacy of chloroquine; however, vertical inhibition of the autophagy pathway further reduces PDAC cell growth, increases apoptosis, and enhances sensitivity to mTORC1 inhibition.
key_points_ko: 자가포식 경로의 상위 및 하위 노드를 동시에 차단하는 수직적 억제는 단일 억제보다 췌장관선암(PDAC) 세포 성장을 더 효과적으로 억제합니다.
VPS34 또는 ULK1/2의 억제는 chloroquine(CQ) 및 PIKfyve 억제제와 작용하여 세포 성장을 저해하고 세포사멸을 증가시켰습니다.
자가포식 수직 억제는 PI3K-AKT-mTORC1 신호전달 경로를 활성화시켜, mTORC1 억제제에 대한 취약성을 높이는 것으로 나타났습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌장관선암(PDAC) 세포 모델에서 자가포식(autophagy) 경로의 여러 단계를 동시에 차단하는 수직적 억제 전략의 효과를 조사했습니다. 연구진은 CRISPR-Cas9 스크리닝을 통해 자가포식 상위 유전자의 손실이 chloroquine(클로로퀸, CQ)으로 인한 성장 억제를 강화함을 확인했습니다. 또한, VPS34 또는 ULK1/2의 억제가 CQ 및 PIKfyve 억제제와 시너지 효과를 내어 세포 성장을 저해하고 세포사멸(apoptosis)을 증가시킴을 입증했습니다. 자가포식 수직 억제는 PI3K-AKT-mTORC1 신호전달 경로의 보상적 활성화를 유도하며, 이는 bi-steric mTORC1 억제에 대한 감수성을 높이는 결과로 이어졌습니다.
title: Vertical inhibition of the autophagy pathway impairs growth and enhances sensitivity to mTORC1 inhibition in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 췌장관선암에서 자가포식 경로의 수직적 억제는 성장을 저해하고 mTORC1 억제에 대한 감수성을 높입니다
